subject: Skull Kid
text: Playing Saria's Song on the ocarina while standing on the stump in front of the lone Skull Kid in the Lost Woods rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head all the way back to the entrance of Lost Woods. Head left from here to find a lone Skull Kid with a flute. Step onto the stump in front of him and play Saria's Song on your Ocarina. He will be so pleased with the melody that he'll give you a Piece of Heart in return.

subject: Gossip Stone
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of a Gossip Stone grants a health-restoring fairy.

evidence.quote: By the way, now that you have Zelda's Lullaby, whenever you see a Gossip Stone, and need health, play the Lullaby in front of the stone. It should grant you a free health-restoring fairy.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Speaking to the cured man in the House of Skulltula after collecting 10 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards the Adult's Wallet, which holds 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Once you gather enough tokens, the curse will be lifted on a family member. We have enough already (need 10), so head into the house....Once inside, talk to the man who isn't a spider, and he'll give you the ADULT'S WALLET, which can hold 200 Rupees.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Dropping down the hole in the fenced area accessible by gliding with a Cucco reveals a small treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Go down the hole here later to find a small treasure chest with a Red Rupee.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Gathering and returning all Cuccos to the pen for the distraught woman awards Link an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Bringing her all the Cuccos will net you another EMPTY BOTTLE.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the lone tree near the entrance of Kakariko Village at night knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Exit the village, then re-enter when night arrives. There's quite a lot of Gold Skulltulas to find. First, roll into the lone tree near the entrance to knock down this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located at the window on the south wall of the Skulltula House at night.

evidence.quote: Next, head to the south wall of the Skulltula House. There's another one right at the window.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the building under construction in Kakariko Village at night.

evidence.quote: Head up to the building under construction. There's a Gold Skulltula up there within easy reach.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the northern part of Kakariko Village near the entrance to Death Mountain at night.

evidence.quote: Next, head up to the northern part of town, up to where the Death Mountain entrance is. There's yet another one here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the ladder of the tall lookout tower south of the Death Mountain entrance, which can be killed with two slingshot shots.

evidence.quote: South of here is a tall lookout tower. Another one is on the ladder of the tower. Kill it with two shots from the slingshot, then climb up the ladder to get the token.

subject: Dampé's Gravedigging Tour
text: Paying the gravekeeper 10 Rupees to dig in dirt sections on the path can uncover a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Talk to him while he's standing on a section of dirt and he'll ask for 10 Rupees so he'll dig in that place. What we're looking for is a Piece of Heart. Let him dig once in each section of dirt on the path until the Piece pops out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the plot of dirt in the Graveyard causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: There's also a plot of dirt similar to the ones in Lost Woods. Drop bugs here, making sure to catch another before they disappear, and another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Pulling the gravestone with flowers in front of it in the Graveyard reveals a hole containing a chest with the Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: There's one particular grave with flowers in front of it. Pull this gravestone to reveal a hole you can drop down. In here is a treasure chest containing a HYLIAN SHIELD.

subject: Treasure chest
text: Pulling the second gravestone on the left facing away from the Royal Family's Tomb at night reveals a hole where playing the Sun's Song spawns a chest with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, facing away from the grave entrance, pull the second left gravestone to reveal another hole. (Make sure it's night, otherwise Navi won't let you pull it.) Fall down this hole, kill the Redead, then play the Sun's Song on the steps to reveal a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

subject: Darunia
text: Playing Saria's Song for Darunia in Goron City prompts him to dance and give Link the Goron's Bracelet.

evidence.quote: Cheer him up by playing Saria's Song. He'll dance to it, then give you the GORON'S BRACELET, which allows you to pick up the bomb from a bomb flower, as you may have seen throughout the city.

subject: Spinning pot
text: Throwing a bomb into the giant spinning pot in Goron City so that it stops on the happy face yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the level just above those circling pot, and grab a bomb from a bomb flower. Time your throw so that the bomb lands into the pot. If it lands on the very happy face, a Piece of Heart pops out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs onto the soft dirt plot revealed after blowing up the boulder outside Goron City causes a Gold Skulltula to emerge.

evidence.quote: Drop down, and you'll see that a plot of dirt has been revealed. Drop some bugs on it (No need to recapture any for right now.) and a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Large treasure chest
text: Blowing up the wall on the west side of the main room in Dodongo's Cavern reveals a large treasure chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: First, head to the west side of the room. Grab a bomb and blow up the wall here. Behind it is a large treasure chest. Opening it will get you the DUNGEON MAP for this area.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Behind a bombable wall blown up by luring a Baby Dodongo on the southeast path of Dodongo's Cavern is a room containing Keese, a torch, and a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Kill that Baby and it'll blow up the wall. After its blown, head through and open the large steel door behind it. There are a bunch of Keese, a torch, and a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Business Deku Scrub
text: A Business Deku Scrub behind the bombable wall in the Dodongo room sells Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees each.

evidence.quote: Behind the steel door is just a Business Deku Scrub who'll sell Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees a piece.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Business Scrub on the far left across the lava pool in Dodongo's Cavern sells Deku Shields for 50 Rupees each.

evidence.quote: There's a Business Scrub at the far left on this side. He sells Deku Shields for 50 Rupees each.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on some vines at the top of the lowered bomb flower staircase in Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Once all of them blow, the staircase will lower. Go up it, and find a Gold Skulltula on some vines.

subject: Large treasure chest
text: Opening the large treasure chest guarded by three statues (including an Armos) behind the wall across from the staircase yields the Compass.

evidence.quote: In here, there are three statues surrounding a large treasure chest. The front one is an Armos, a live statue. Touch it to wake it, then throw a bomb at it to kill it....Open the chest to get the COMPASS for this dungeon.
